name: script-prefs-read
script:
set p to PlistOpen ((POSIX file "$FILES/prefs.plist") as alias)
PlistGet p key "String_Utils_Script_Path"
PlistClose p

name: script-prefs-new-save
script:
set p to PlistNew
PlistSet p key "String_Utils_Script_Path" to "/Users/me/x.scpt"
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/script-prefs.plist")
PlistClose p
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$TMP/script-prefs.plist")
PlistGet p
PlistClose p

name: script-prefs-update
script:
set p to PlistNew {String_Utils_Script_Path:"old"}
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/update.plist")
PlistClose p
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$TMP/update.plist")
PlistSet p key "String_Utils_Script_Path" to "new"
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/update.plist")
PlistClose p
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$TMP/update.plist")
PlistGet p key "String_Utils_Script_Path"
PlistClose p

script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch (PlistChild p key "people") key "pet"
PlistClose p

name: match-key-value
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch (PlistChild p key "people") key "age" value 30
PlistClose p

name: match-key-value-text
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch (PlistChild p key "people") key "first" value "Bob"
PlistClose p

name: match-none
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch (PlistChild p key "people") key "zzz"
PlistClose p

name: match-value-type
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch (PlistChild p key "people") key "age" value "30"
PlistClose p

name: match-using
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch (PlistChild p key "people") using "pet"
PlistClose p

name: match-not-array
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistMatch p key "name"
PlistClose p

name: add-arrays-after
add-arrays-before
add-dicts
add-dicts-before
add-list
script:
set r to PlistNew {"a"}
PlistAdd {"b", "c"} after r
PlistGet r
PlistClose r

name: add-record
script:
set r to PlistNew {a:1}
PlistAdd {b:2} after r
PlistGetXML r
PlistClose r

name: add-mismatch
add-no-target
save-xml
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/save-xml.plist")
PlistClose p
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/save-xml.plist")

name: save-binary
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/save-binary.plist") with binary
PlistClose p
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$TMP/save-binary.plist")
PlistBinaryFormat p
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: save-without-in
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/save-again.plist")
PlistSet p key "a" to 2
PlistSave p
PlistClose p
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/save-again.plist")

name: save-new-without-in
save-opened-without-in
script:
PlistSave (PlistNew {a:1}) in (POSIX file "$TMP/opened.plist")
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$TMP/opened.plist")
PlistSet p key "a" to 3
PlistSave p
PlistClose p
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/opened.plist")

name: save-binary-opened
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/binary.plist")
PlistSave p in (POSIX file "$TMP/from-binary.plist")
PlistClose p
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$TMP/from-binary.plist")
PlistBinaryFormat p
PlistClose p

name: save-missing-folder
save-child
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSave (PlistChild p key "d") in (POSIX file "$TMP/child.plist")
PlistClose p
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/child.plist")

name: binary-format-new

name: document
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
set r to PlistDocument (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistEqual p to r
PlistCount r
PlistClose p

name: document-not-open
script: PlistDocument (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")

name: document-string
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistCount (PlistDocument "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistClose p

name: pool-default
script:
GetPool (PlistNew)
PlistListDocuments "mtc-none"

name: pool-set
script:
set old to SetPool "mtc-a"
set p to PlistNew {a:1}
GetPool p
PlistCount (item 1 of (PlistListDocuments))
SetPool old
DeletePool "mtc-a"

name: pool-in-pool
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1} in pool "mtc-b"
GetPool p
PlistListDocuments "mtc-b"
PlistClose p
PlistListDocuments "mtc-b"

name: pool-open-in-pool
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist") in pool "mtc-c"
GetPool p
PlistDocument (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist") in pool "mtc-c"
PlistDocument (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistClose p

name: pool-delete
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1} in pool "mtc-d"
DeletePool "mtc-d"
PlistGet p

name: pool-delete-missing
script: DeletePool "mtc-never"

name: pool-delete-default
script:
SetPool "mtc-e"
set p to PlistNew
DeletePool
SetPool ""
PlistGet p

name: pool-set-returns-previous
script:
SetPool "mtc-f"
SetPool "mtc-g"
SetPool ""

name: pool-list-new-documents
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1} in pool "mtc-h"
set r to PlistNew {"b"} in pool "mtc-h"
set docs to PlistListDocuments "mtc-h"
count docs
DeletePool "mtc-h"

name: pool-list-opened
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist") in pool "mtc-i"
PlistListDocuments "mtc-i"
PlistClose p

name: pool-get-child
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:{b:1}} in pool "mtc-j"
GetPool (PlistChild p key "a")
PlistClose p

name: docid
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSetDocID p to "mine"
PlistEqual p to (PlistGetDocByID "mine")
PlistSetDocID p to "other"
PlistClose p

name: docid-missing
script: PlistGetDocByID "mtc-no-such-id"

name: docid-after-close
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSetDocID p to "closed"
PlistClose p
PlistGetDocByID "closed"

name: docid-duplicate
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
set r to PlistNew {b:1}
PlistSetDocID p to "dup"
PlistSetDocID r to "dup"
PlistCount (PlistGetDocByID "dup")
PlistClose p
PlistClose r

name: docid-in-pool
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1} in pool "mtc-k"
PlistSetDocID p to "pooled"
PlistGetDocByID "pooled"
PlistCount (PlistGetDocByID "pooled" in pool "mtc-k")
PlistClose p

name: docid-child
hidden-retain
